educationalGoal: Biological functions are expressed by a highly complex system of biomolecules including proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids. Students also learn the functions of proteins in immune system and some examples for drug design.

              学習・教育目標

              1.Proteins Structures & Functions
2.Enzyme Inhibitors
3.Immune System
4.Signal Transduction
5.Polypeptide Synthesis

              Biological functions are expressed by a highly complex system of biomolecules including proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids. Students learn the reaction mechanisms of some enzymes and inhibitors and the intercellular signal transduction system. Students also learn the functions of proteins in immune system and some examples for drug design.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Structures, Functions, and Application of enzymes and inhibitors

2. Intercellular signal transduction system

3. Proteins function in immune system

4. Polypeptide synthesis

5. Analytical methods for Biomolecules

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbook: Fundamentals of Biochemistry (ed. H. Inoue), Biology (ed. N. Yoshimura); Reference book: , Biology and Cell biology, 4th ed. (ed. Masaru Wada), Polymer Chemistry (K. Miyamata et al.); Reserved bools: not specified

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              It is desirable that you take basic biochemistry and applied biochemistry. Knowledge of organic chemistry, physics chemistry and analytical chemistry is necessary to understand the function of proteins in biological systems. It is good to read the textbook and to organize the important matters on the summary notebook.
